exposure: History of cesarean delivery for arrest of descent (failure of fetal head engagement or unsuccessful instrumental delivery)
Previous cesarean delivery indication (arrest of descent vs. other indications)
history of vaginal delivery subsequent to prior CD for arrest of descent
cesarean delivery for arrest of descent
outcome: Success rate of vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC)
cohort: 480 women with previous cesarean delivery undergoing trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
finding: A history of cesarean delivery for arrest of descent was not independently associated with unsuccessful VBAC; however, a history of vaginal delivery subsequent to prior cesarean delivery for arrest of descent was a significant predictor of successful VBAC.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean delivery for arrest of descent was not independently associated with unsuccessful VBAC.
